request.description: Production-path compatibility check for the new deterministic MuJoCo physical-characterization measurement.
request.rationale: Before relying on a longer physical characterization, verify that the measurement loads the pinned native MuJoCo model, applies bounded commands, advances repeated substeps, exposes 20 ms block observations, and correctly resets across repeated and open/folded configuration transitions. This check tests implementation compatibility and known controlled consequences; it is not evidence of task success or a scientific conclusion about the bottleneck.

request.description: Deterministic physical characterization of compiled two-joint-arm dynamics under bounded commands, at extended/open/folded postures, with native substep and 20 ms control-block traces.
request.rationale: The initial model identifies stabilization versus reach as the first direction-setting distinction, while compiled inertia, torque authority, coupling, damping, and folded-posture behavior remain unquantified. This controlled measurement does not train or alter the official task; it measures the mechanisms that determine whether a learned policy can brake and settle within the 1 cm tolerance at the 20 ms action rate. If responses show ample authority and rapid decay across configurations, the next direction should be baseline learning with official-exposure diagnostics; if they show saturation, strong configuration-dependent coupling, or slow settling, the next direction should prioritize velocity-aware or model-informed control and targeted measurements before interpreting policy failures.
